android.desc: Get to your apps fast with Type Launcher. Combines a dock for your favorites with an app list that finds the right app based on usage and fast keyboard search. Optional widgets pages and work profile support.

quotes.text:
- Mobile-friendly Hacker News client with pinning and offline support: https://newshacker.app/

- Android weather app that tells you what to wear: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.clothescast

- Android launcher with fuzzy find: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=app.typelauncher

- Webapp to view your ancestors on a world map: https://gedmap.com

- vcs wrapper around git, hg, and jj: https://github.com/mikelward/vcs

- Migrate my bash and zsh configs to fish and nushell: https://github.com/mikelward/conf
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What are tools you have made for yourself since the advent of AI?
